name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_error
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::OnDownloadError reports an error status, waits briefly, and marks the standalone download dialog as failed.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The wider download event-sink vtable is still under reconstruction; this target verifies the callback body directly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442680 validates a stdcall callback that calls WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::SetStatusTextFmt("ERROR"), calls imported Sleep(1000), stores -1 to g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadDialogResult, returns S_OK in eax, and pops two stack arguments.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_error_smoke patches USER32 SetDlgItemTextA through the real SetStatusTextFmt path and KERNEL32 Sleep, then verifies the error text, progress HWND, control id 1023, global status buffer pointer, one-second sleep, dialog result -1, and S_OK return.
